categories.description: A refreshing alcoholic beverage made from fermented grains, typically barley, flavored with hops for a balanced bitter and aromatic taste
An elegant alcoholic beverage made from fermented grapes, available in red, white, and rosé varieties, each offering unique aromas and flavors
High-proof distilled alcohols such as vodka, whiskey, rum, and gin, known for their bold flavors and versatility in cocktails or straight pours
Light, fruity alcoholic drinks that combine spirits or wine with juice, soda, or other mixers, perfect for casual and refreshing enjoyment
A traditional Japanese alcoholic drink brewed from rice, offering a smooth, subtly sweet or dry flavor, served warm or chilled

products.title: Bachelet Ramonet Morgeot Chassagne-Montrachet 1er Cru 2020
products.description: From a fourth-generation family farm, this wine is crafted in a classic style. It opens with aromas of mayflower, acacia, honeysuckle, verbena and hazelnut. The palate is both elegant and opulent, with suggestions of honey and ripe pear underscored by a profound flinty minerality.

products.title: Gloria Ferrer Blanc de Noirs
products.description: Very pale pink tinge. This has an intriguing, evolved nose that incorporates ripe red berry fruit with plenty of toasty-yeasty autolytic character, moist barley, toasted almonds and wildflower honey. The palate is full, rich and creamy, with a vague impression of sweetness but impressive depth and length overall. This is a bold and satisfying, powerful yet balanced bubbly from Sonoma, with superior depth and concentration. Score - 91. (John Szabo, MS, winealign.com, May 3, 2017)

products.title: Icellars Reserve Red 2019
products.description: This wine is a blend of 72% Cabernet Sauvignon, 25% Cabernet Franc and 3% Malbec, all grown on a single estate vineyard in Niagara-on-the-Lake. The wine spent over a year in a mix of French and American oak barrels, adding complex smoky and spicy shading to the rich dark berry and evergreen notes. Pair with rack of lamb.

products.title: The Quiet Man Traditional Irish Whiskey
products.description: This dram speaks volumes. Bourbon cask matured and remarkably smooth with citrus, honey, and floral accents. The palate showcases vanilla, sweet oak, and spice notes. Medium-bodied and well-balanced with a long, lingering finish. Try with Irish stew, seared steak and fluffy mashed potatoes or craft an Irish coffee cocktail.

products.title: Bacoo 5YO Rum
products.description: Upon the first sniff, this Dominican rum will remind you of the islands. You're greeted by ripe mango, pineapple, and banana tones. Further notes of melon, guava and baking spice are also present. Full-bodied and fruity with a luscious mouthfeel and a balanced finish. Pair with roast pork and lightly fried plantain slices.

products.title: Teremana Blanco Tequila
products.description: The much-anticipated arrival of Teremana Blanco is entering the tequila ring. Global superstar Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson is behind this exciting spirit. Expect star-studded notes of citrus, agave, vanilla, and earth. It's medium-bodied and warm, with a lengthy finish. Match with pulled pork tacos, or neat after dinner.

products.title: Teremana Reposado Tequila
products.description: The success of global superstar Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson is undeniable. He's known for being a huge tequila fan, so creating his own line came naturally. Anticipate vanilla, oak, honey, chocolate and herbal notes. It's medium-bodied and smooth with a long, warm finish. Pair with roasted vegetables and Queso añejo sliders.

products.title: Bud Light Seltzer Variety Pack
products.description: This sizzling seltzer variety pack from Bud Light is a must-get! Included are two 473 mL cans each of mango, black cherry and strawberry. They're light and refreshingly crisp, 110 calories and 1 g of sugar per 473 mL serving. A great match for light appetizers, barbecued fare, or enjoy as an aperitif.

products.title: Nomad Firefly Rosé Sparkling 2021
products.description: The 2021 vintage of this Charmat-method rosé sparkler is composed of 100% Cabernet Franc. It's bright, fresh and cheery, with wonderful aromatic lift and buoyant fruit flavours. The gentle hint of sweetness is balanced by a fine acidity. A refreshing, pleasurable wine for sipping under a sunset or with spicy seafood.

products.title: Santa Rita Casa Real Reserva Especial Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
products.description: Casa Real Reserva Especial is from a combination of the oldest vineyards that Santa Rita has planted on the alluvial terraces of its property in Alto Jahuel, in Alto Maipo - Carneros, planted in the early 1970s, and Pobalación, in the early 1980s, both with very low yields. Aged for 18 months in barrels (70% new oak), this is a Chilean classic. It has undergone major changes since the 2017 vintage, however, both in the harvest date (earlier) and in the extraction (now softer), and this has resulted in a slight shift in style toward redder fruit and a more delicate body. In this 2018, the strength of the tannins is contained and polished, surrounded by a layer of red fruits and herbal notes that are typical of the area. This wine still needs five years to begin to show its true potential. Score - 98. (Patricio Tapia, guiadescorchados.cl, 2021)

products.title: Ebb & Flow Raspberry Lemon Yuzu
products.description: This crimson-coloured sour is the latest addition to the Ebb & Flow Series. Containing fresh raspberry, tart lemon, and citrusy yuzu notes, it's sweet, tart, and tangy with a flavourful finish. Pair with haddock and chips, a charcuterie board, or lemony chicken dishes.

products.title: Holsten Premium Pilsner
products.description: Medium gold colour; light hop & cooked grain aromas with underlying pear notes; clean finish

products.title: Kilikanoon Killerman's Run Shiraz
products.description: This Shiraz is Kilikanoon's idea of an entry-level wine. Some introduction! A hedonistic pleasure, it's plush with apricot and black plum jam, floral lift and mixed berries fruit. A bold match for barbecued spareribs, spicy sausage pizza or grilled hanger steaks.

products.title: Yalumba Organic Viognier 2021
products.description: A splendid expression of the variety showing apricot, mango, potpourri and orange peel aromas, followed by a concentrated palate displaying richly textured mouthfeel and beautifully pitched acidity, offering awesome drinking. At its best: now to 2025. Score - 94. (Sam Kim, wineorbit.co.nz, Sept. 2021)

products.title: Canadian Club Whisky
products.description: The legend of Canadian Club began in 1858 and grew to become one of the world's most iconic whiskies. Pouring a medium gold you will find aromas of roasted almond, vanilla and pepper; with spicy vanilla, cornflakes and a faint nutty flavour on a medium weight palate with a long finish.
